test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the following types of lines with their correct descriptions according to their orientation and characteristics.

Description

A. A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it.

B. A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines.

C. A line that changes its direction continuously.

D. A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane.
solution:
The correct answer is __Option 2__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it is correctly matched to Option 3__.
 
• A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines is correctly matched to __Option 2__.
 
• A line that changes its direction continuously is correctly matched to __Option 4__.
 
• A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane is correctly matched to __Option 1__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Parallel lines:**

 
 
• Parallel lines do not meet or intersect and are equidistant from each other.
 
• They remain at the same orientation throughout.
 
 
 
• **Perpendicular lines:**
 
 
• Perpendicular lines intersect at a 90-degree angle.
 
• They form right angles at their intersection point.
 
 
 
• **Curved lines:**
 
 
• Curved lines continuously change direction and do not have a fixed slope.
 
• They can be circular, elliptical, or irregular.
